menuItems.name: SUJA-SHAMDRAY
menuItems.description: Traditional Bhutanese-style dish prepared with fresh vegetables, aromatic spices and a rich, flavorful sauce. Served hot with butter tea (suja).

menuItems.name: CAESAR SALAD WITH GRILLED CHICKEN BREAST
menuItems.description: Fresh crisp lettuce, grilled chicken breast, Caesar dressing, Parmesan cheese and crunchy croutons, finished with freshly ground pepper.

menuItems.name: POTATO WEDGES
menuItems.description: Golden crispy potato wedges seasoned with herbs and spices. Served with a creamy dipping sauce.

menuItems.name: FISH & CHIPS
menuItems.description: Crispy battered fish served with golden French fries, fresh salad and tartar sauce.

menuItems.name: PRAWN TEMPURA
menuItems.description: Succulent prawns lightly coated in a delicate, crispy tempura batter and deep-fried to golden perfection. Served with Japanese-style dipping sauce and fresh salad.

menuItems.name: SPAGHETTI CARBONARA
menuItems.description: Spaghetti Carbonara is a classic Italian pasta dish made with spaghetti, eggs, cheese, cured pork, and black pepper.

menuItems.name: TOMATO THO TSHE
menuItems.description: A traditional Bhutanese vegetarian dish made with fresh tomatoes, onions, green chillies and Bhutanese spices. Simple, fresh and flavorful.

menuItems.name: GOLDEN EGG FRIED RICE
menuItems.description: Fragrant rice wok-fried with eggs, fresh vegetables and aromatic seasonings, finished to a delicious golden perfection.

menuItems.name: CHICKEN KHATSHU
menuItems.description: Tender chicken cooked with a flavorful Bhutanese-style sauce, fresh chillies and aromatic spices. Served with steamed rice.

menuItems.name: TERIYAKI CHICKEN
menuItems.description: Juicy grilled chicken glazed with a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, garnished with sesame seeds and spring onions. Served with steamed rice.

menuItems.name: TERIYAKI BASA
menuItems.description: Tender Basa fillet glazed with a rich sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, finished with sesame seeds and spring onions. Severed with steamed rice.

menuItems.name: BEEF BURGER
menuItems.description: Juicy seasoned beef patty served in a soft burger bun with fresh lettuce, tomato, onion, cheese and our signature burger sauce. Served with French fries.

menuItems.name: PIZZA (Bacon, Chicken & Cheese Pizza)
menuItems.description: Freshly baked pizza topped with crispy bacon, seasoned chicken and generous melted cheese on a golden, crispy crust.

menuItems.name: SPICY CHICKEN WINGS
menuItems.description: Crispy chicken wings tossed in a bold and spicy sauce, seasoned with aromatic herbs and spices. Served with a dipping sauce.

menuItems.name: CHICKEN CHILLI
menuItems.description: Tender pieces of chicken stir-fried with fresh green chillis, onions, bell peppers and aromatic spices in a flavorful chilli sauce.

menuItems.name: PRAWN CHILLI
menuItems.description: Succulent prawns stir-fried with fresh green chillis, onions, bell peppers and aromatic spices in a flavorful sweet and spicy chilli sauce. Served hot and garnished with spring onions.

menuItems.name: ESPRESSO
menuItems.description: Concentrated full-bodied shot of fresh artisanal roasted coffee with a thick, golden crema.

menuItems.name: AMERICANO
menuItems.description: Double shot of rich espresso topped with piping hot pure mountain spring water.

menuItems.name: CAFÉ LATTE
menuItems.description: Espresso balanced with steamed silky microfoam milk and delicate barista latte art.

menuItems.name: CAPPUCCINO
menuItems.description: Harmonious balance of espresso, steamed milk, and a thick cushion of velvety foam, dusted with fine cocoa.

menuItems.name: MOCHA
menuItems.description: Rich espresso blended with dark bittersweet chocolate and steamed milk, topped with light foam.

menuItems.name: WHITE MOCHA
menuItems.description: Velvety espresso combined with creamy melted white chocolate and gently textured warm milk.

menuItems.name: CARAMEL MACCHIATO
menuItems.description: Freshly steamed milk with vanilla-flavored syrup marked with espresso and finished with caramel drizzle.

menuItems.name: MACCHIATO
menuItems.description: Bold espresso marked with a small dollop of creamy microfoam.

menuItems.name: CORTADO
menuItems.description: Equal parts espresso and warm milk to gently reduce acidity while retaining coffee intensity.

menuItems.name: FLAT WHITE
menuItems.description: Double shot of espresso expertly integrated with velvety steamed whole milk for a punchy coffee note.

menuItems.name: HOT CHOCOLATE
menuItems.description: Comforting rich Belgian cocoa melted with fresh whole milk and a hint of vanilla.

menuItems.name: MILK TEA
menuItems.description: Fragrant steeped black tea simmered with fresh milk and crushed Himalayan cardamom.

menuItems.name: LEMON HONEY TEA
menuItems.description: Soothing hot mountain tea infused with freshly squeezed lemon and pure organic wildflower honey.

menuItems.name: ICED AMERICANO
menuItems.description: Chilled double espresso shots poured over crystal ice and cold spring water for a crisp pick-me-up.

menuItems.name: ICED MATCHA
menuItems.description: Premium ceremonial Japanese matcha green tea whisked smooth, served over cold milk and clear ice.

menuItems.name: ICED LATTE
menuItems.description: Fresh espresso poured gently over cold milk and ice cubes for a refreshing coffee break.

menuItems.name: ESPRESSO SHAKER
menuItems.description: Double espresso vigorously hand-shaken with ice and cane sugar syrup, creating an ultra-creamy chilled froth.

menuItems.name: JACK DANIEL’S
menuItems.description: Tennessee sour mash whiskey known for its mellow balance of caramel, vanilla, and toasted oak notes.

menuItems.name: BLACK LABEL
menuItems.description: Johnnie Walker Black Label 12-Year blended Scotch whisky with rich dried fruit, smoke, and cedar aromas.

menuItems.name: RED LABEL
menuItems.description: Johnnie Walker Red Label scotch with bold, vibrant spices and a long smoky finish.

menuItems.name: DOUBLE BLACK
menuItems.description: Intense, smoky interpretation of Black Label, aged in heavily charred oak casks for profound depth.

menuItems.name: K5
menuItems.description: Bhutan’s premier coronation whiskey, specially crafted to honor the 5th Druk Gyalpo with smooth grain warmth.

menuItems.name: MISTY PEAK
menuItems.description: Artisanal Himalayan small-batch craft whiskey with subtle alpine heather and honeyed malt notes.

menuItems.name: LAGER
menuItems.description: Crisp, refreshing golden lager beer served ice cold with a bright malt finish.
Renowned super-strong Bhutanese malt lager with high gravity and rich body.

menuItems.name: HIGH LAND
menuItems.description: Traditional Bhutanese highland spirit distilled with pure mountain glacier water.

menuItems.name: SOJU
menuItems.description: Clear, smooth Korean distilled spirit served chilled in traditional small glasses.

menuItems.name: BREEZER
menuItems.description: Refreshing fruit-infused alcoholic cooler served over ice.

menuItems.name: COKE (CAN)
menuItems.description: Classic Coca-Cola 330ml chilled can served with ice and lemon slice upon request.

menuItems.name: SPRITE (CAN)
menuItems.description: Refreshing lemon-lime Sprite 330ml chilled can served with ice.

menuItems.name: LIPTON
menuItems.description: Chilled Lipton iced tea in refreshing peach or lemon flavor.

menuItems.name: WATER (1000ML/ 500ML)
menuItems.description: Pure Himalayan natural mountain spring mineral water.

menuItems.name: MOJITO
menuItems.description: Refreshing blend of white rum, fresh muddled mint leaves, tart lime wedges, pure cane sugar, and sparkling club soda.

menuItems.name: BLUE LAGOON
menuItems.description: Electric blue cocktail made with vodka, Blue Curaçao liqueur, and zesty fresh lemonade over crushed ice.

menuItems.name: MARGARITA
menuItems.description: Crisp tequila, triple sec, and freshly pressed lime juice, served in a chilled glass with a Himalayan pink salt rim.

menuItems.name: TEQUILA SUNRISE
menuItems.description: Vibrant layers of tequila, freshly squeezed orange juice, and rich red grenadine giving a radiant sunrise effect.

menuItems.name: COSMOPOLITAN
menuItems.description: Sophisticated cocktail combining citrus vodka, triple sec, tart cranberry juice, and freshly squeezed lime.

menuItems.name: WHISKEY SOUR
menuItems.description: Smooth bourbon whiskey shaken with freshly squeezed lemon juice, cane sugar, and aromatic Angostura bitters.

menuItems.name: DAIQUIRI
menuItems.description: Classic Cuban recipe with fine white rum, fresh lime juice, and simple cane syrup, shaken ice-cold.

menuItems.name: SEX ON THE BEACH
menuItems.description: Fruity cocktail of vodka, peach schnapps, orange juice, and cranberry juice served over crushed ice.

menuItems.name: SCREWDRIVER
menuItems.description: Highball drink made with smooth triple-distilled vodka and fresh sweet orange juice garnished with an orange slice.

menuItems.name: VIRGIN MOJITO
menuItems.description: Muddled fresh garden mint, crushed lime wedges, cane sugar syrup, and fizzy sparkling soda over crushed ice.

menuItems.name: BLUE LAGOON MOCKTAIL
menuItems.description: Non-alcoholic Blue Curaçao syrup mixed with zesty citrus lime, chilled Sprite, and crushed ice.

menuItems.name: SHIRLEY TEMPLE
menuItems.description: Classic mocktail of ginger ale or lemon-lime soda with sweet grenadine, garnished with a maraschino cherry.

menuItems.name: LEMON MINT COOLER
menuItems.description: Freshly squeezed mountain lemon, bruised sweet mint, and chilled Himalayan water with a touch of rock salt.

menuItems.name: SUNRISE MOCKTAIL
menuItems.description: Chilled natural orange juice layered with a sweet grenadine base, creating an eye-catching mountain sunrise gradient.

menuItems.name: CRANBERRY SPRITZER
menuItems.description: Tart mountain cranberry juice topped with bubbly sparkling soda, fresh lime squeeze, and fresh rosemary sprig.
